name: Podcast intro
summary: A short signature with space for the host.
instruments: Felt piano, plucked bass, soft brushed percussion
exclusions: Lead vocals, heavy bass, dense midrange
arrangement: 0–3 s: memorable motif. 3–11 s: reduce density under the host. 11–15 s: resolve with a clean handoff.

name: Documentary bed
summary: A slow build that leaves dialogue intelligible.
instruments: Sparse piano, low strings, gentle texture
exclusions: Trailer hits, sudden transitions, sharp mids
arrangement: Open with texture, introduce a restrained motif, leave room for narration, then resolve without a dramatic hit.

name: Social cut
summary: An immediate hook and a clean ending for short video.
instruments: Tight drums, muted bass, bright plucks
exclusions: Long intro, abrupt clipping, dominant vocal
arrangement: Opening hook in the first second. Build with one clear change midway. End on a short edit-friendly accent.

name: Ambient loop
summary: A quiet texture designed for a seamless repeat.
instruments: Soft pads, distant piano harmonics, subtle field texture
exclusions: Heavy percussion, hard ending, large dynamic jumps
arrangement: Evolve the texture gradually. Match the opening harmony and tail at the loop boundary.

name: Vocal theme
summary: A simple topline direction with lyrics kept separate.
instruments: Fingerpicked guitar, upright bass, soft percussion
exclusions: Dense layering or processing that obscures the lyrics
vocals: One close, expressive lead vocal. Keep phrasing natural and leave room between lines.
arrangement: Brief instrumental opening, intimate verse, fuller chorus, and a gentle ending.
